study: Glanville fritillary exploratory annual positive-transition minimum single-step relaxation
scientific_estimand: For each year t in 2007..2012, among survey-comparable patches newly recorded positive at t following recorded zero at t-1, and a declared set of prior positive candidate sources, compute for each host-disparity threshold delta the smallest maximum single-step geographic distance r such that EACH newly recorded-positive target has at least one candidate source reachable in one hop with host-disparity <= delta. It is conditional model consistency, not observed dispersal.
primary_target_rule: positive numerical population at t, recorded numerical population ==0 at t-1, with complete t-1 host features and valid patch coordinates
source_rule: positive numerical population at source observation year; both host columns present at that year
environmental_units: published ordinal host-plant score 0..3 (descriptive analyst convention)
distance_measure: Euclidean projected patch centroids converted from meters to km only after independent genotype-patch centroid concordance

genetic_coordinate_verification.description: Compare matched genotype patch ETRS-TM35FIN centroids to survey patch_network x,y; numeric alignment prerequisite for geographic km

within_source_access: 2019 74,065 patch/year survey rows, 2017 8,322 master input/output rows; genome family uses (ID,Year) join
family_measure: Number of independently reconstructed within-Year+Region+FamilyID groups appearing in >=2 patches and their undirected patch-pair Euclidean distance distribution. Family ID does not specify mother or movement direction.
family_id_gate: At least 95% input ID/year pairs must match master-output ID/year pairs; keep all original outputs without repair.
reported_exploratory_quantities: annual source and newly-recorded-positive target counts for both source policies
per-year minimum required max geographic step for each ordinal delta
source-policy sensitivity of the minimal radius at fixed delta
undirected reconstructed family multi-patch separation summary for 2007-2012
effect of omitting missing-coordinate or missing-host rows, reported as data audit
baseline_comparator: nearest previous-year occupied patch without host constraint (delta=3) from same frozen source roster
claim_restrictions: positive transition after observed zero is NOT proven colonization due imperfect detection
no historical source identification, parental origin, barrier crossing, unobserved long-distance immigration or true maximum dispersal
2019 and 2017 archives involve the same long-term research system; never count this as fully independent biological replication
host-score disparity is not independently validated physiological tolerance
no strong model superiority or causal selection result from this exploratory source
do not publish individual patch IDs, genotype rows, or family identifiers in output artifacts
stop_rules: fail closed if archive SHA mismatch or key/coordinate gate fails
do not infer geographic km if coordinate consistency not demonstrated
do not invent missing values, source labels or barriers
report no feasible source for a target as unresolved, not biological impossibility
if any year has zero eligible targets or candidate sources, report non-estimable rather than drop silently
source_transport: One verified source acquisition per frozen pair in this exploratory analysis; previous transport checks do not license outcome-based file substitution.
reporting: aggregate-only JSON with code/data fingerprints, no individual row output
source_lookback_priority: For prior-two-year sources, use the most recent eligible source observation first
